assumptions.target: 1 minus untreated/treated measured relative harvest yield
assumptions.source: BASF documented MCALCR ratios; no mass units inferred
assumptions.candidate_selection: No evaluation-driven model or leaf selection; report all predeclared domains
assumptions.missing_leaves: Require every leaf in the declared domain; do not fill missing with zero
assumptions.observation_windows: Common measured dates within each source leaf; all-three windows can differ
assumptions.predictor_units: fraction-days of recorded severity contrast; not HAD or absolute healthy area
